Register Individual.description: Registers a new individual in the social registry.

Register Household Group.description: Registers a new group registrant, such as a household.

Add Member To Household.description: Adds an individual to a group with a role, e.g. head of household.

Update Individual.description: Updates details on an existing individual registrant.

Enroll In Program.description: Enrolls an individual or group in a social protection programme.

Unenroll From Program.description: Removes an individual or group from a programme.

Search Individuals.description: Searches individual registrants with an Odoo-style domain filter.

Get Individual.description: Gets one individual registrant by spp_id.

Get Household Members.description: Lists the members of a group registrant.

Get Enrolled Programs.description: Lists the programmes an individual or group is enrolled in.

List Programs.code:
// List programmes (name and program_id).
getPrograms({ limit: 100 });

Search Areas.description: Searches administrative areas, e.g. to map a district code to an area.
